title: 2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球团体赛赛制说明书
excerpt: 2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球团体赛赛制说明书（点击查看详情）
content:
【2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球团体赛赛制说明书 】

参赛队伍：20支团体队伍
判标准：采用国际乒联（ITTF）现行团体赛规则，采用A-X，B-Y，C-Z，A-Y，B-X的顺序，每场五局三胜，大盘五场三胜。
第一轮：20进12（淘汰赛）
第二轮：12进6（淘汰赛）
第三轮：6进3（淘汰赛：将产生晋级半决赛的三个队伍）
复活赛：3进1（循环赛：在6进3比赛中失利的三支队伍将进行循环赛，并以大比分积分，积分最高的队伍将晋级半决赛）
半决赛：4进2（淘汰赛）
决赛：2进1（淘汰赛：将产生冠军队伍与亚军队伍）
title_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules
excerpt_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules (click for details)
content_en:
【2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules】

Participating teams: 20 team entries
Match rules: the current ITTF team event rules apply. Ties are played in the order A-X, B-Y, C-Z, A-Y, B-X. Each match is best of five games; each tie is best of five matches.
Round 1: 20 to 12 (knockout)
Round 2: 12 to 6 (knockout)
Round 3: 6 to 3 (knockout: the three surviving teams advance to the semifinals)
Repechage: 3 to 1 (round robin: the three teams eliminated in the "6 to 3" round play a round robin and are ranked on aggregate tie score; the team with the highest aggregate score advances to the semifinals)
Semifinals: 4 to 2 (knockout)
Final: 2 to 1 (knockout: the champion and runner-up teams are decided)
